nodes.title: READ ME 1: how to use
widgets_values:
HOW TO USE THIS WORKFLOW

Most of the time you only look at the CONTROL PANEL (top left). Everything else is set once.

1. Once: pick your models in 'Loader' and a language model in 'Prompt writer'.
2. In the CONTROL PANEL: choose ONE CLIP (a video of the length you set, written from one idea) or SEVERAL PARTS (a long video made part by part, a box per part).
3. Write your idea in the panel. Like it? Save it in the Ideas bar (Save / Save as) and flip between your saved ideas with the arrows.
4. Pick the prompt template, and switch on what the video is made from (first frame, references, extend a video, second pass).
5. References: the panel lists the files you chose in the Load nodes below and lets you tick each one on or off. Choose files, describe them, and use 'Upload' to add new ones.
6. Press Run. The written prompts and a timing report appear at the end; SAVE VIDEO saves the video.

To try another scene: only change the idea in the panel (or pick another saved idea). References and settings stay as they are.

nodes.title: READ ME 2: modes
widgets_values:
MODES - what the video is made from (all combine freely; switches are in the CONTROL PANEL)

TEXT TO VIDEO: nothing ticked in the references; write the idea.
IMAGE TO VIDEO: put a picture in FIRST FRAME and keep 'use_first_frame' on: the video starts exactly with it.
REFERENCE TO VIDEO: choose pictures / videos / sounds in the Load nodes and describe them. In the idea you can say 'the woman from <Picture 1>', 'the voice of <Audio 1>', 'like <Video 1>'. Numbers follow the order of the ticked references (first frame = Picture 1 when used; soundtracks of reference videos come before the standalone sounds).
EXTEND A VIDEO: choose the video in VIDEO TO EXTEND and tick it: the new video continues it and the result contains both.
ONE CLIP: any length (clip_seconds). SEVERAL PARTS: each part 5 or 10 s (or '(8s)' at the start of a part box), joined with the Continuity settings.
PROMPT WRITER OFF: your text is used as the finished prompt, exactly as written (use_prompt_writer).
QUICK PREVIEW: switch two_stage_upscale off: first pass only, much faster, for trying ideas. On = full quality.
SMOOTHER MOTION: un-bypass the interpolation node (select it, Ctrl+B) and set Save Video frame_rate to 48.

nodes.title: How
widgets_values: Pick the diffusion model, the text encoder and the VAEs once. The extra VAE (2x detail) decodes every part at twice the size. LoRAs apply to the model. The prompt writer is a separate small language model that turns your idea into H3 prompts.

widgets_values_named.text: Pick the diffusion model, the text encoder and the VAEs once. The extra VAE (2x detail) decodes every part at twice the size. LoRAs apply to the model. The prompt writer is a separate small language model that turns your idea into H3 prompts.

nodes.title: How
widgets_values: Up to 9 reference pictures plus the first frame. Each node: choose the file, write what it is (or keep the stored description), switch 'enabled' on - or tick it in the CONTROL PANEL. Use them for characters, places, objects, styles.

nodes.title: How
widgets_values: Up to 3 reference videos with their sound (2-15 seconds is best). Use for motion, a person's look and voice, a camera move. Upload adds a file from your computer.

widgets_values_named.text: Up to 3 reference videos with their sound (2-15 seconds is best). Use for motion, a person's look and voice, a camera move. Upload adds a file from your computer.

nodes.title: How
widgets_values: Up to 3 sounds: a voice, music, an effect. They are provided to the model as they are; the description only tells the prompt writer what each one is. Upload adds a file from your computer.

nodes.title: How
widgets_values: To extend a video you already have: upload / choose it in VIDEO TO EXTEND (max_seconds 0 = all of it), enable it, tick 'extend_existing_video' in the panel. The result starts with your video and continues it.

widgets_values_named.text: To extend a video you already have: upload / choose it in VIDEO TO EXTEND (max_seconds 0 = all of it), enable it, tick 'extend_existing_video' in the panel. The result starts with your video and continues it.

nodes.title: How
widgets_values:
Video format: size and seconds per part.
Continuity: how parts join (parts mode).
Sampling: first pass (defaults follow 10Eros Max: er_sde, sgm_uniform, 8 steps, shift 12/3).
Second pass: upscales and refines with 3 steps; the panel switch turns it off.
Live preview: what you watch while it samples.
Speed and memory: sparse attention (turn off for models that are not FastH3-based).
